prompt:
Instrumental only, no vocals, no voice, no lyrics. Total length: exactly 2 minutes 50 seconds.
Epic dark phonk meets cinematic orchestral trailer music, for a short film on 2,000 years of human population: empires rise and fall, plagues, wars, then the modern explosion of humanity.
Tempo: strict, steady 129 BPM in 4/4 for the whole piece, D minor. Every beat must be clear and on the grid (the film is cut to the beat). No tempo changes, no rubato.
Sound: drift-phonk cowbell lead melody, heavily distorted 808 bass, hard trap drums with crisp hi-hats, Memphis-style percussion, layered with epic orchestral strings, brass stabs, low choir and taiko.

[0:00 - 0:06] Intense opening: a massive orchestral + 808 hit on every beat, cowbell riff above, rising tension.
[0:06 - 0:08] Rewind: reverse cymbal and a tape-stop / vinyl rewind sweep with rising chirps, then a short silence.
[0:08 - 0:42] Drop: full drift phonk groove, cowbell lead melody, distorted 808, driving and aggressive.
[0:42 - 1:02] Same groove, darker: low choir pads join, a big impact at 0:42.
[1:02 - 1:24] Peak energy: brass and taiko join, heavy and epic, big impacts at 1:02, 1:14 and 1:23.
[1:24 - 1:49] New theme: string ostinato over the phonk beat, building, the age of ships and machines.
[1:49 - 2:11] Solemn war section: drums drop to sparse half-time, no cowbell, low strings, cello, distant choir, a slow tolling low bell, quiet and respectful.
[2:11 - 2:32] Explosion: everything returns, the biggest and brightest section, full phonk drums, cowbell melody with the whole orchestra, uplifting and epic.
[2:32 - 2:44] Breakdown: drums stop, reflective piano and soft strings.
[2:44 - 2:50] One final huge cinematic hit, then let it ring out to silence.

description.en: Epic dark phonk meets cinematic orchestral trailer: drift-phonk cowbell lead, distorted 808 bass, hard trap drums, strings, brass stabs, low wordless choir and taiko. Steady 129 BPM grid, D minor, made for beat-cut edits.
description.zh: 史诗暗黑 Phonk 加电影预告片管弦：漂移 Phonk 牛铃主旋律、失真 808 贝斯、硬核 Trap 鼓，叠弦乐、铜管重音、低沉无词合唱和太鼓。全曲稳定 129 BPM，D 小调，适合卡点剪辑。

metadataBasis: description, style, tempo, key, moods and energy are prompt intent (instrumental prompt; some prompts ask for a wordless choir); duration is measured; no automated audio review
